items.idea: Why do Teeth not Grow Back?
items.notes: Maybe ask audience if they every chipped their tooth and had to get composite bonding or a crown or a root canal. The rest of our body including muscles and bones can grow back but why not teeth. Talk about what exactly a tooth is made up and why it can not grow back - can talk about the different layers of the teeth and describe what dentists have to do these procedures if needed.

items.idea: Does Orange Describe the Fruit or the Color?
items.notes: Talk about how orange can be both the fruit and color, and answer like which one was named first, and go into depth on that. Also, talk about any other cases like this if there are any.

items.idea: Why do you get a Bruise?
items.notes: Talk about what a bruise is and the different types and the reasons why it appears. Go into depth on a biological level too. And talk about different levels of severity and the recovery progress. Give some tips on how to recover from a bruise faster.
